captions.detailed: This is a 3D model of a benchtop teaching microscope. It features a broad, rounded rectangular beige base and a matching vertical support arm. Mounted on the arm is a black mechanical stage with a side carriage, a rotating objective turret with multiple dark objectives, and a monocular eyepiece tube angled upwards. Independent black coarse and fine focus knobs are located on the side of the support column. Articulations include a continuously rotating nosepiece turret, a prismatic sliding optical body for vertical focusing, a prismatic sliding side carriage on the stage, and independent continuous rotations for both focus knobs.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a benchtop teaching microscope using CadQuery. The microscope should have a broad, rounded beige base, a vertical support column, and a separate black mechanical stage with a side carriage. Ensure it includes a monocular optical tube, a rotating objective turret with multiple objectives, and independent coarse and fine focus knobs on the side of the column. Define continuous rotational joints for the turret and both focus knobs, and prismatic sliding joints for the optical body and the stage carriage.
captions.factory: The model is built using an ArticulatedObject framework. The base, vertical column, and stage support are constructed as a single beige rigid part using combined Box and Cylinder primitives. The mechanical stage is created as a black rectangular plate with a central aperture. The side carriage is modeled as a separate slider. The optical body consists of a vertical cylinder, a horizontal cylinder block, and an angled cylinder for the monocular tube. The objective turret is modeled as a flat cylinder nosepiece carrying multiple thin cylindrical objectives. Independent cylindrical knobs representing the coarse and fine focus controls are placed coaxially on the side. Joint definitions include prismatic joints for the vertical focus column and stage slider, and continuous revolute joints for the turret nosepiece and both focus knobs.
